Built and rendered — no defects in any size.

- **Structure:** one full-height root column stack (stretch constraints) so every band is full width: header → photo band → 3 equal `fill` candidate columns → red CTA bar → 3 check steps → spacer → footer.
- **Photo:** `fit: fill` inside a clipped band, so it crops (41% / 55% / 30% vertical) instead of distorting; band height adapts per size via `at`.
- **Per-size tuning:** `at` bumps type and icon sizes for the 0.28-scale skyscraper (smallest text 13px) and trims the photo band at `wide` so nothing compresses.

Renders: `portrait-v6.png`, `wide-v6.png`, `sky-v6.png`.
